_comment: Vanillify's own entries, merged over the UAD-ng list. Only what was verified on a real phone: removal tier, source, findings (adware, telemetry, phones_home, listening, financing_lock, locked) and a note. A field left out keeps UAD-ng's value.

com.facebook.appmanager.note: Facebook's silent updater, preinstalled whether or not you use Facebook.

com.facebook.system.note: Facebook App Installer: installs Facebook apps without asking.

com.amazon.appmanager.note: Amazon's app installer. Some Motorola phones disable it themselves and refuse to let it be removed.

com.glance.lockscreenM.note: Glance: ads and sponsored content on the lock screen.

com.dti.motorola.note: Digital Turbine Ignite: manufacturers are paid to let it install apps silently during setup and later.

com.iosgalleryigallery.iphonegallery.description: Gallery app pushed by Digital Turbine during setup, not chosen by the user.

com.ironsource.appcloud.oobe.hutchison.note: ironSource Aura: offers and installs sponsored apps during setup.

com.aura.oobe.motorola.note: ironSource Aura: offers and installs sponsored apps during setup.

com.motorola.playautoinstallext.note: Play Auto Installs: installs partner apps during setup.

com.inmobi.weather.note: Weather app from the InMobi ad network.

com.payjoy.access.note: PayJoy device-financing lock. Remove only if the phone is fully paid off. Motorola blocks all shell access to it; on a phone that isn't financed it stays disabled.

com.motorola.paks.note: Not an app bundle, as older lists say: on current Motorola phones this is PAKSFinance, a financing lock. It is a protected package and disables itself when the phone isn't financed.

com.android.devicelockcontroller.note: Google's Device Lock controller, used by phone-financing programs.

com.motorola.ccc.devicemanagement.note: Uploads Motorola's check-in data: events that every Motorola app writes to a shared log. Keep it installed, but blocking its network stops the uploads. Check that system updates still work afterwards.

com.motorola.batterycare.note: Battery Care holds a live Firebase Remote Config connection, runs A/B tests and uploads weekly check-in data, including how long apps ran. Blocking its network keeps the charging features.

com.motorola.audiorecorder.note: Recorder keeps a live Firebase Remote Config connection. Recording works without network.

com.motorola.createwithai.note: Image Studio: Firebase Remote Config and cloud AI.

com.motorola.enterprise.adapter.service.note: Contains Firebase Analytics (app-measurement.com). Only needed on work-managed phones.

com.motorola.paks.notification.note: Notifications for the PAKS financing lock; uses Firebase.

com.motorola.android.nativedropboxagent.note: Uploads system crash and dropbox entries.

com.motorola.ccc.notification.note: Motorola Notifications: promotional messages from Motorola's cloud.

com.motorola.appforecast.note: Shown as "Performance": part of Motorola's app-launch optimisation, not telemetry.

com.motorola.carrierconfig.note: On phones where carrier configuration comes from com.google.android.carrier, disabling this didn't affect calls or VoLTE.

com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox.note: The Google app listens for "Hey Google" through a privileged path that Android's "only while in use" rule doesn't cover.

com.google.android.as.note: Android System Intelligence runs permanently and holds microphone access for ambient audio features.

com.google.android.feedback.note: Market Feedback Agent: sends crash reports to Google.

com.google.android.partnersetup.note: Google Partner Setup: tags your searches with the manufacturer's client ID.

com.google.android.adservices.api.note: Privacy Sandbox ads: Topics and ad measurement. Some phones refuse to disable this system module.

com.google.android.federatedcompute.note: Federated learning: trains models on your data and uploads the results.
